subject: POC prompt dataset collection — next steps and eval plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt dataset collection — next steps and eval plan

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the POC smoothly: 

- Success criteria (customer to confirm): ACME's internal CSAT for generated summaries >= 4/5 and automated F1 for entity extraction >= 0.82 on the provided eval set.
- What we need from you this week: a representative prompt set (50–200 prompts) and a small logs sample (500–2,000 rows) containing user input, model responses, and a simple success label where available. Prefer JSONL for prompts and CSV for logs.
- Redwood will: 1) map prompts to eval buckets (summarization, Q&A, extraction), 2) run baseline models (redwood/fast-1 and open/opt-6b quantized) against the set, 3) produce an eval report with per-bucket metrics and failure cases.
- Timeline: intake by 2028-03-14, baseline run 03/15–03/18, deliver eval report by 03/21.
- Ownership: Samantha (Acme) provides data; Marissa (Redwood) owns evaluation and report; Aditya/Dev own runtime/config support during the POC.

Can you confirm the success criteria above and share a sample prompts file and logs dump by end of day 03/14? If the formats differ, please include a README explaining column/field mappings.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_poc_eval_plan.xlsx (POC eval plan template)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Jade Kim <jade.kim@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset collection — next steps and eval plan

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the success criteria look good to us; we'll target the CSAT and entity F1 thresholds you noted. A few clarifications: 

- For CSAT, our labels are on a 1–5 scale in the logs; we can convert to binary >=4 for the POC if that helps.
- For prompts: we'll push a JSONL with ~120 prompts across the three buckets. Expect a mix of short and long-form prompts; we'll flag those for the summarization bucket.
- Logs: attaching a small sample (acmecorp_request_logs_sample.csv) and a sample prompts file (acmecorp_sample_prompts.jsonl) to this thread. The full export will be delivered via the Drive link.

We will also include a README.csv describing column names. Can you confirm Redwood needs de-identified user IDs or full IDs? We can provide de-identified IDs by default.

Samantha
Principal Product Manager
AcmeCorp
Samantha.lee@acmecorp.com

Attachments: acmecorp_sample_prompts.jsonl; acmecorp_request_logs_sample.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset collection — next steps and eval plan

Hi Samantha —

Perfect, thanks for sending the samples. We prefer de-identified user IDs for the initial run, that keeps things simple from a compliance perspective. A few notes on the intake and our eval plan (also attached as the filled redwood_poc_eval_plan.xlsx):

- Format checks: Aditya will validate JSONL/CSV schema on 03/14 and flag any parsing issues. If we hit missing labels, we'll default to using heuristics (e.g., CSAT >= 4).
- Eval mapping: we'll split prompts by bucket and run baseline models with the same prompt formatting you provide (no prompt rewriting unless you request it).
- Metrics: ROUGE-L for summarization, Exact match + F1 for extraction, mean CSAT / top-1 accuracy for Q&A.
- Failure analysis: we'll include 20 representative failures with model output, prompt, and suggested mitigations.
- Timeline update: intake validation complete by 03/14 EOD, baseline runs 03/15–03/17, preliminary findings 03/19, final report 03/21.

Next concrete ask: can you confirm the Drive link where the full export will land and whether the logs include timestamp and latency columns (we use latency to help cost estimates)?

Thanks — looping Aditya to own the schema validation.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood_poc_eval_plan_filled.xlsx
